note: `memberDid` is required — a grant names the member it makes a vetter.
`memberDid` is a DID, not a display name or member handle. The role credential's subject is the DID the vetter signs statements with.
A role credential valid for less than a day cannot outlast the vetting it is meant to cover; 86400 seconds is the floor.
Two years (63072000 seconds) is the ceiling. Eligibility is re-granted, not granted for good.
`validitySeconds` is an integer count of seconds, not a duration string.
No role selector. This task grants the vetter role and nothing else; a `role` member would turn it into a general role grant reachable under a vetting-specific authority.
